text:
Clara M: Quick heads-upI pushed a fresh draft of the launch post into the shared doc: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1NewLaunchDraft. Need copy + legal sign-off before we lock for Monday publish.
Devon R: Reviewing now. Two quick asks: 1) can we simplify the hero subhead, 2) add one line about migration assistance for existing customers?
Ethan H: Agree on migration line. Maybe: 'easy migration path for existing model endpoints' - short and reassurance-y. Also, benchmark box needs a methodology note.
Clara M: Good call. I'll trim the subhead to 'Predictable inference for production' and add the migration sentence under the 'Getting started' section.
Devon R: On CTAswe should have two: 'Read the launch guide' and 'Register for demo webinar' with UTM parameters. Priya/legal will likely want the benchmark footnote before approving.
Legal - Priya: For any performance or cost claims please include: (a) test baseline, (b) date, (c) whether numbers are median/mean, and (d) an appendix link to raw logs or dashboard. No 'best' or 'always' language.
Ethan H: Noted. I'll paste the perf dashboard link and add a short footnote: '(internal perf trace, n=30k, median latency and per-token cost, March 2026). Raw CSV attached in doc appendix.'
marketing-bot: Reminder: content freeze at 18:00 PT today for the Tuesday publish slot.
Clara M: Webinar specificswe want a technical demo + 15-min AMA. Devon can you confirm speakers?
Devon R: I'll host with an infra engineer (Nikhil) and a PM (Ethan). Nikhil can you do a 10-min deep-dive on routing/fallback?
Ops - Nikhil: Yep I can. I'll also verify the lead capture webhook and add the sample payload to the routing doc. Suggest adding query params: utm_source=blog, utm_campaign=prod_launch_apr, lead_source=blog_post, campaign_id=launch_apr_2026.
Ethan H: Add a parameter for model_hint so we can pre-populate demo context, e.g., model=redwood-v2.
Clara M: Good. We'll use that in the blog demo button. Can someone draft the pre-fill link?
Devon R: Draft link: https://redwood.ai/webinar?utm_source=blog&utm_campaign=prod_launch_apr&lead_source=blog_post&model=redwood-v2. Will add to doc.
Legal - Priya: Once the footnote + appendix are in place I'll do a final review. Also flag: avoid 'enterprise-grade' as an unqualified claim; 'enterprise-ready with optional SLAs' is safer.
Clara M: Understood. Editing now. Can we get approvals by 16:30 PT? I need 30m to schedule the announcement and queue the social posts.
Devon R: I'll drop a final copy edit by 15:30. Ethan will confirm appendix links by 15:45.
Ethan H: Appendix links uploaded. Raw logs in doc attachment, perf dashboard link included.
Legal - Priya: Reviewingif everything is present I'll add an approval note at 16:10 PT.
Ops - Nikhil: Routing sheet updated with webhook sample and SFDC field mapping: lead_source -> Origin, campaign_id -> Campaign_Code. QA steps included.
Clara M: Thanks team. If Legal signs off we'll freeze at 18:00 and publish Tuesday 09:00 PT. Devon please prepare the short post copy for social.
Devon R: On it. I'll post draft social and a 2-line email blurb in the doc comments.
marketing-bot: Action required: please react with :white_check_mark: to this thread once you've completed assigned items.
